analysis.purpose: cmdExport implements the `crib export` CLI command. It parses --format and --procedure flags, resolves the project root, validates indexing, enforces format/procedure constraints, opens the runtime soul store, and renders the export output via renderExport.
responsibilities: Parse --format and --procedure flags and their values
Collect remaining non-flag positionals as project root candidates
Resolve the project root from cwdOverride, first positional, or default
Validate that the requested format is one of the supported formats
Validate that the root is indexed
Require --procedure for rules and mermaid formats
Open the runtime soul store and render the export output
Catch render errors and return EXIT.ERROR

businessRules.rule: Supported formats are rules, mermaid, graph.json, and report
businessRules.rationale: The formats array is declared and an includes check rejects anything else

businessRules.rule: Project root resolution prefers cwdOverride, then first positional (unless '.'), then default
businessRules.rationale: resolveProjectRoot is called with explicitRoot set to ctx?.cwdOverride ?? (positional[0] && positional[0] !== '.' ? positional[0] : undefined)

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: CLI arguments including --format, --procedure, and optional project root

sideEffects: Writes error messages to process.stderr for bad args, missing index, or missing procedure
Writes rendered export output to process.stdout
errorBehavior: Missing procedure for rules/mermaid returns EXIT.BAD_ARGS
renderExport throws are caught and returned as EXIT.ERROR
invariants: Format is validated before the indexed check
Index is validated before renderExport is called
renderExport errors are surfaced rather than crashing the CLI
preconditions: A supported format must be requested
The project root must be indexed
postconditions: Either the rendered export is printed or an appropriate exit code is returned
risks: 2 unresolved call sites (String constructor and path.join) are not modeled
Manual flag parsing advances index with ++i; missing flag values are not explicitly validated
whatToDistrust: Unresolved built-in calls: String and join (path.join)
renderExport internals are not validated in this seed
